candidates.name: Monzo Bank Limited
candidates.description: Monzo is a financial services platform that offers various accounts, savings plans, investments, credit cards, and mortgages. Its main functionality includes providing tools for managing money, earning cashback on purchases, and facilitating online banking with features like bill payments and mobile payment options. Monzo also emphasizes security through its anti-money laundering network and offers investment plans starting at £1 per month, along with 24/7 customer support to assist users with their financial needs.

candidates.name: DepositScout Ltd.
candidates.description: DepositScout is a platform that helps users compare and find the best savings accounts in the UK, specifically Easy Access accounts and various types of ISAs (Investment In Savings) under £1,000. Users can access information on current rates, including base rates and fixed interest rates, to make informed decisions about their savings options. The site also offers resources such as news articles, expert analysis, and tips for switching banks and saving accounts.
candidates.rationale: DepositScout is a savings-account comparison and rate-alert site, not a digital bank offering accounts, cards, payments, FX, or investing.

candidates.name: Starling Bank Limited

Its main functionality includes managing finances, organizing budgets, and protecting customer money through various accounts such as fixed savings, Easy Saver, and Flexible Cash ISA options. It offers two investment strategies: EURO 2% for euros and USD 8%, with instant deposit options through personal IBANs or stablecoins. The app also provides opportunities for referral programs, allowing individuals to earn up to 5% on their savings while sharing their earnings with others.
candidates.rationale: Both offer consumer financial apps with deposit accounts, savings products, payments, and account management, serving users seeking app-based banking alternatives.

The bank emphasizes personalized banking experiences by reviewing applications based on individual needs and goals, ensuring a straightforward process for users. Key features include daily, annual interest rates, flexible account options, and the ability to withdraw funds as needed after term ends.

candidates.name: Wio Bank PJSC

The bank emphasizes security with biometric security measures and customer support seven days a week.

The site aims to simplify the investment journey for users by providing clear guidance on how to save effectively and manage their finances.

candidates.name: cahoot

Cahoot also provides customer security software and resources for personal finance needs.

candidates.name: Chase UK
candidates.description: Chase UK offers a range of financial services including debit and credit card rewards, cashback on everyday spending, and investment opportunities through J.P. Morgan Personal Investing. Customers can earn up to 2% cashback for purchases made with Chase cards, which include items like groceries, restaurants, transport, and public EV charging points. The bank also provides various banking products, including current accounts, savings accounts, and investments, along with 24/7 customer support for account management and investment advice.

candidates.name: 1click2pay
candidates.description: 1Click2Pay is a global payment solution that allows users to make payments without borders. Users can also access additional services like travel assistance and property management.

candidates.name: COROFIN
candidates.description: Corofin is a financial comparison portal that helps users find the best financial services for various needs, including current accounts, loans, and investment options. Key features include no account management fees, fast application times, and a focus on transparent pricing without hidden costs. Users can access these tools to make informed financial decisions.

candidates.name: Explore Amex Global Lounge Collection
candidates.description: American Express is a credit card company that offers a range of products and services including personal, business, and travel cards. candidates.name: Tiny Debit
candidates.description: Tiny Debit is a service that allows users to create and pay tiny direct debit payments for bank switching. The platform automatically scans UK banks for current cash rewards and provides various payment plans tailored to different user needs, with flexible amounts ranging from daily payments to monthly bonuses. Users can also access support through their mobile app and website for managing their accounts and banking transactions.

candidates.name: Zitra Bank
candidates.description: Zitra Bank offers a range of financial products designed to help individuals and businesses manage their savings, investments, and loans. candidates.name: Digital Pecunia
candidates.description: Digital Pecunia is an online platform that helps users compare and select financial products across various categories. candidates.name: Altery EU Ltd.

candidates.rationale: TaylorFinance primarily offers insurance and mortgages, not a digital banking super-app centered on payments, cards, FX, and investing.

candidates.name: Brigit
